test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who is the Chairman of the NITI Ayog?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Prime Minister.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Prime Minister** is the Chairman of the NITI Ayog.
 
• With the expertise and abilities to move quickly, support research and innovation, offer the government a strategic policy vision, and handle unforeseen difficulties,** NITI Aayog is becoming into a cutting-edge resource centre.**
 
• Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog is** Mr. Parameswaran Iyer.**
 
• The Republic of India's head of state is the **Prime Minister of India.**
 
• On May 30, 2019,** Shri Narendra Modi **began his second term as India's prime minister by taking the oath of office. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Vice President of India serves as the head of state of the **Indian Republic's executive branch.**
 
• As part of their oath of office,** the president's primary responsibility is to uphold, defend, and maintain **the Indian Constitution and the law.
 
• The head of the Indian government's ministry of finance is known as the **minister of finance. **
